issues.evidence: The blue office cuts to a near-white chatbot, then bright Word and dark hands. Measured luma: 46.4 → 202.9 at 00:08; 198.5 → 66.4 at 00:15.6. Overall luma SD is 64.0. The eased transition softens the first cut but leaves a large sustained brightness difference.
issues.suggested_action: Compress illustration UI whites to approximately 78–82 IRE and gently lift stock midtones; match settled frames across these cuts without flattening the night atmosphere.

issues.evidence: The Excel proof, white memo and dark Changes panel alternate sharply: luma 98.2 → 167.8 → 55.8 → 31.0; saturation 69.3 → 29.7 → 75.8 → 73.5. White pages dominate one frame while dark panels dominate the next.
issues.suggested_action: Match document paper whites across the real demo, slightly lift dark panel midtones, and hold the surrounding teal background at one exposure; preserve original status and diff colors.

issues.evidence: The typing hands look warm brown beside the cool blue protagonist, while the mouse insert is substantially darker. Measured insert luma varies from 66.4 at 00:15.6 to 16.5 at 00:24.07 and 18.8 at 01:24.
issues.suggested_action: Balance each insert to the office reference using cool shadows and neutral skin midtones; raise the darkest inserts selectively until fingers and desk surfaces retain visible separation.

issues.evidence: The protagonist's face appears muted grey-brown under the blue office light, particularly in the head-in-hands close-up. The office wide has saturation 118.2 and the later reaction 113.0, concentrated visually in blue surroundings rather than healthy skin separation.
issues.suggested_action: Use a tracked skin qualifier to reduce cyan contamination and add restrained red warmth and midtone exposure, leaving the office shadows blue.

issues.evidence: The Word notification frames have a bright central paper area and heavily shaded corners; the straight Word frame is much brighter. Measured luma changes from 198.5 at 00:12.3 to 95.0 at 00:16.5. Across supplied UI frames, edge shading sometimes makes paper appear grey.
issues.suggested_action: Separate intentional notification dimming from the finishing vignette; use a fixed, broad vignette on the surrounding composition and reduce shading over document text and paper.

issues.evidence: Only 2.7% of shots are detected as letterboxed; the first Done shot reports 96 letterbox rows while every other shot reports zero. The supplied frame also contains extensive dark surround, which could trigger the detector.
issues.suggested_action: Verify whether these rows are actual bars or dark composition content; if actual bars, remove them to preserve the continuous 16:9 finish.

top_revision: Match UI paper whites and stock midtones within each world to reduce exposure jolts while preserving the deliberate warm dawn.

problem_world.recipe: Starting point for stock: eq=contrast=1.04:brightness=0.012:gamma=1.06:saturation=0.88; colorbalance=bs=0.018:gs=0.006:rs=-0.008. Apply shot-specific exposure matching before this look.
problem_world.secondary: Protect skin with a tracked qualifier, reducing cyan locally and adding slight red warmth; retain shadow texture rather than lowering the black floor.
problem_world.ui: Use a luminance curve with normalized points 0/0, 0.25/0.25, 0.5/0.48, 0.75/0.69, 1/0.82 on illustration layers before compositing; keep alert red saturated.
problem_world.finish: Use one broad vignette with approximately 0.15-stop edge loss; optional monochrome grain at 0.4% on stock and backgrounds, keeping small UI text clean.

solution_world.recipe: Keep teal backgrounds consistent; for screenshot layers use curves=master='0/0 0.1/0.12 0.5/0.5 0.8/0.76 1/0.88', then match paper whites between Excel and memo.
solution_world.secondary: Preserve cyan branding and native Accept/Reject/diff colors; lift dark panel midtones selectively rather than adding saturation globally.
solution_world.finish: Use the same broad vignette strength throughout the demo, applied principally to the background; avoid halation on text and interface borders.

dawn_world.recipe: Starting point: eq=contrast=1.03:gamma=1.04:saturation=0.92. Preserve the existing warm sky; gently lift desk shadows with a masked curve.
dawn_world.finish: Retain the shared restrained grain and vignette; keep the sunrise as the intentional first warm scene.

worst_jumps.issue: Office → chatbot: luma +156.5, saturation −105.3; the transition eases entry but the destination remains much brighter.
Dark insert → chatbot: luma +171.3; abrupt dark-to-white alternation within the problem world.
White memo → Changes panel: luma −112.0, saturation +46.1; content coverage contributes substantially, but perceived brightness still jolts.
Email → mouse insert: luma −153.4; the insert loses substantial shadow detail before returning to the bright email.

assessment_limits: CINEMATOGRAPHY.md was not found in the project or searched reference locations; the available sibling SHARED.md was read.
Whole-frame luma and saturation statistics include changes in UI coverage and composition; they do not independently establish a hard grade discontinuity.
